confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Peruvian tourist pricing, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is more uncertain and assumes July peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine anchors lean on the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value came from an RBA exchange-rates overview page surfaced in search snippets; I did not open the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Peruvian tourist cities, adjusted down from Cusco-level tourist pricing and up from Lima budget-tier pricing. Sol-to-USD conversion assumed at roughly 3.5 to 3.7 soles per USD.
